userStories.title: Load and Parse PRD.json
userStories.description: As a user, I want the application to load tasks from the `prd.json` file on startup so that I can see the current session's work items.
acceptanceCriteria: Application reads `prd.json` from the filesystem root or configured path
JSON content is parsed into a strictly typed interface/model
Handle missing or malformed `prd.json` gracefully (show error or empty state)
Display the count of loaded tasks in the UI

userStories.title: Map Statuses to Kanban Columns
userStories.description: As a user, I want tasks to appear in the correct columns based on their status so that I can understand the progress.
acceptanceCriteria: Map unknown/other statuses to a default "Backlog" or "To Do" column
Render basic card information (Title, ID) in the column

userStories.title: Real-time File Watcher
userStories.description: As a user, I want the board to update automatically when I modify `prd.json` externally so that I don't have to manually refresh.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement a file watcher (e.g., `chokidar` or Node `fs.watch`) on `prd.json`
Trigger a data reload immediately upon file change detection
Update the UI state without a full page reload
Debounce rapid updates to prevent UI flickering

userStories.title: Read-only UI Enforcement
userStories.description: As a user, I want to be prevented from moving cards or editing them on the board so that I don't mistakenly think I'm updating the source file.
acceptanceCriteria: Disable drag-and-drop functionality for these specific cards
Hide or disable "Add Item" buttons for the mapped columns
Visual indication (e.g., lock icon or badge) that these items are managed externally via `prd.json`
